nodes.label: Lifecycle Fold Recomputable Decision
nodes.rationale: Keeps modifications out of extraction because replies often lack symbol or side and must be folded over durable raw messages.

nodes.label: Deletion Evidence Durable Projection Decision
nodes.rationale: Persists deletion observations because the live snapshot used to detect them is ephemeral and cannot be recomputed later.

nodes.label: ProviderScore Recomputable Scorecard Decision
nodes.rationale: Avoids stale persisted scores by recomputing over durable evidence and excluding evidence-free components with notes.

nodes.label: Codebase Structure Boundary Decision
nodes.rationale: Refines existing responsibility boundaries without adding churn from a new application layer before the MVP needs it.

nodes.label: Platform Is End State Not MVP
nodes.rationale: The full platform is too broad to validate before a narrow wedge proves value.
nodes.norm_label: platform is end state not mvp

nodes.label: Signal Is A First Class Dataset
nodes.rationale: Performance truth depends on reconstructable evidence and later research can reuse the signal dataset.
nodes.norm_label: signal is a first class dataset

nodes.label: Execution Outside MVP
nodes.rationale: Business value is proof before demo or live execution risk.

nodes.label: Milestone G Live Execution
nodes.rationale: Live mode is delayed until demo proof, compliance review, explicit controls, hard risk caps, and full audit export exist.

nodes.label: Observe-Only Exchange Mode
nodes.rationale: The MVP promises simulated outcomes and evidence, not execution, returns, exchange credentials, or live autonomy.

nodes.label: Candidate Filter
nodes.rationale: The candidate filter is recall-first and advisory, so misses remain recoverable by deterministic parse, LLM fallback, or audit.

nodes.label: FoldedSignal
nodes.rationale: The folded view is derived and recomputable from durable lifecycle evidence, so it is never stored.

nodes.label: ProviderScore
nodes.rationale: The score is recomputed on demand from durable evidence so weights and formulas can change without losing traceability.

nodes.label: Service Interfaces
nodes.rationale: Telegram, LLM CLI, market data, and Postgres are behind protocols so tests can run pure and offline.
